description: Machine-readable multi-stage charge/discharge records. See verification per stage.

recording.method.status_label: per-sample stage label in the raw data
recording.method.policy_string: per-cell protocol string in the raw data
recording.method.waveform_only: no stage field; stages visible only as current steps
recording.method.not_in_raw: raw files carry no information about stages

stage.verification.raw_label: stage and order read from raw per-sample label; rate measured
stage.verification.raw_policy_string: parsed from the raw per-cell policy string
stage.verification.documented_only: from author/landing/paper text; not seen in the raw data

units.c_rate: multiples of C; denominator differs per dataset, see notes and c_rate_basis
units.soc_range_pct: percent state of charge, null where no source gives it

recording.summary: Per-cell string C1(Q%)-C2 = CC at C1 up to Q% SOC, then CC at C2 up to 80% SOC. The cycle data (I, Qc, Qd, Qdlin, T, Tdlin, V, discharge_dQdV, t) has no step or stage column.

scope.missing: the third batch file (2018-04-12) is not in Raw_Dataset; its cells are not covered

notes: 6 cells have truncated policy strings in the raw file (both fields); unparsed rates are null and nothing was reconstructed: 2017-06-30_c7, 2017-06-30_c8, 2017-06-30_c9, 2017-06-30_c12, 2017-06-30_c15, 2017-06-30_c16.
When Q = 80 the second CC stage covers 80%-80% and is omitted.
Stages with verification=documented_only (CC-CV 1C to 3.6 V from 80% SOC; discharge 4C CC-CV to 2.0 V, C/50 cutoff) come from the curation/paper text, not from the raw files.

Ad-hoc check, 2 cells x 1 cycle only (batch-1 cells 3 and 10, cycle 10): measured current / 1.1 A was about 0.9 x the labelled C-rate for every plateau (e.g. 4C label -> 3.6, 5.4C -> 4.9, 3C -> 2.7, discharge 4C -> 3.6). The denominator behind the labels is therefore not established; c_rate values here are the labels as written, not measured rates.

recording.summary: Each sample is a 128x8 charge-segment window plus a dict with label, car, charge_segment, mileage and capacity. No stage field; current changes inside a window are unlabelled.

scope.missing: only the first 300 samples of battery_dataset3 were read; datasets 1 and 2 were not

observations.derived_by: ad-hoc scan 2026-10-07, not reproduced by this script

notes: Pickles are legacy torch-save streams. They were read with torch.load(weights_only=False) in the ad-hoc scan, not through SafeUnpickler.

recording.summary: chargestatus is a charge-state flag, not a stage label. Multi-stage charging appears only as stepped current plateaus inside charging sessions.

scope.missing: one vehicle (vin93) only; stage structure not extracted as records

observations.derived_by: ad-hoc scan 2026-10-07 of vin93.csv (1,203,513 rows), not reproduced by this script
observations.plateau_rule: runs of >=5 rows within 3 A of the run start; plateaus >=5 A apart count as distinct

notes: Code meanings (1/3/4/255) are not defined anywhere in Raw_Dataset; they were not mapped here.

recording.summary: The raw files hold per-cycle capacity, partial-charge curves and a Workingprofile string (e.g. ':CC-UDDS-CC-CT'). Nothing describes a charge protocol or its stages.

documented_only.applies_to: dataset 1 (mapping of the 30 Dataset1_Dataset2 cells to dataset 1 vs 2 is unknown)

conflicts.metadata_says: datasets/dataset_39.json: multi-stage CC-CV charge for dataset 1
conflicts.raw_shows: processed_metadata/dataset_39_CQU_metadata.csv labels these cells plain CC-CV with C_rate unknown

observations.derived_by: h5py structure and string fields of all three .mat files, 2026-10-07

notes: Stage SOC boundaries are not given by any source read.

recording.summary: Per-sample Status label. Discharge stages are labelled discharge_0..3 in time order. Charge has two labels: 'Constant current charge' (5C stage) and 'Constant current-constant voltage charge' (1C CC stage and the CV phase merged under one label). Per-stage rates are not stored as metadata; they are read from measured current.
